_doc: Controlled claim-strength vocabulary. The ENFORCED contract: a claim doc may only use a tier-N claim word if its vertical's ledger ceiling is >= tier N. See VOCABULARY.md for the human contract and the deliberate limits of what this catches.

tier_evidence.demonstrated: Ran at least once on real inputs. No control and no held-out set required. This is the honest floor for exploratory work; it is never flagged.
tier_evidence.discriminated: Blinded scoring (scorer cannot see outcomes) AND a null/control baseline to beat. In-sample is permitted at this tier.
tier_evidence.validated: A held-out cohort the method was never tuned on, AND a control baseline, AND stated N >= 20.
tier_evidence.predictive: Forward or walk-forward out-of-sample, AND a control, AND a realized outcome recorded (not pending).
